# Pak Multilinks Hygiene — Official Knowledge Base & LLM Index

> Pak Multilinks Hygiene is Lahore's leading wholesale distributor and corporate supplier of tissue paper products, washroom hygiene supplies, commercial cleaning chemicals, and institutional disposable items.

## Core Wholesale Product Categories
1. **Tissue Paper Products** (`https://www.pakmultilinks.com/shop/tissue-paper-products`):
   - Facial Tissues (Pop-up boxes, executive luxury cubes, soft packs 100/150/200 sheets). Category page: https://www.pakmultilinks.com/shop/facial-tissues
   - Soft Pack Tissues (Pocket tissues, party packs, perfumed soft packs). Category page: https://www.pakmultilinks.com/shop/soft-pack-tissues
   - Toilet Rolls & Bathroom Tissues (Commercial jumbo rolls, embossed 2-ply and 3-ply rolls). Category page: https://www.pakmultilinks.com/shop/tissue-rolls
   - Kitchen Towels, Table Napkins & Party Packs (Interfold napkins, dinner napkins, dispenser napkins). Category page: https://www.pakmultilinks.com/shop/paper-napkins
2. **Washroom & Restroom Supplies** (`https://www.pakmultilinks.com/shop/washroom-supplies`):
   - Soap dispensers (Manual push and touchless automatic sensor units).
   - Jumbo Roll Tissue (JRT) dispensers and C-fold/M-fold hand towel dispensers.
   - Hand dryers (High-speed automatic warm air dryers).
   - Urinal screens, toilet seat sanitizers, and air freshener automatic dispensers.
   - Liquid hand wash and hygiene refills. Category page: https://www.pakmultilinks.com/shop/hand-wash
3. **Cleaning Products & Chemicals** (`https://www.pakmultilinks.com/shop/cleaning-products`):
   - Disinfectant white & black phenyl (Concentrated and diluted bulk cans).
   - Liquid hand wash refills (5-litre corporate drums and perfumed pump bottles).
   - Commercial floor cleaners, multi-surface degreasers, and glass cleaners.
   - Toilet bowl acid cleaners, bleach, and surface sanitizers.
   - Mops, wipers and floor care tools. Category page: https://www.pakmultilinks.com/shop/floor-surface-care
4. **Disposable & Janitorial Items** (`https://www.pakmultilinks.com/shop/disposable-items`):
   - Heavy-duty garbage bags / trash can liners (Small, Medium, Large, Extra-Large 30x40 to 40x50 inches).
   - Disposable paper cups (6.5oz, 8oz, ripple cups) and wooden stirrers.
   - Microfiber cloths, wet floor mops, steel wipers, and cleaning tools.

- **Shine Well**: Commercial liquid hand wash and surface care solutions. Brand page: https://www.pakmultilinks.com/brand/shine-well
- **Airnergy**: Premium fragrance aerosols for offices and commercial spaces.
- **Pak Multilinks OEM**: Custom printed napkins, private label tissues, bulk corporate drums.

## Commercial Terms & Ordering Policies
- **Target Customers**: Corporate offices, healthcare facilities, hospitals, restaurants, hotels, educational campuses, industrial plants, salons, and retail wholesalers.
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)**: PKR 5,000 or 1 wholesale carton.
- **Delivery Service in Lahore**: Same-day or next-day scheduled direct delivery across Gulberg, DHA, Bahria Town, Model Town, Johar Town, Sundar Industrial Estate, and all commercial zones.
- **Nationwide Dispatch**: Daily cargo and freight transport to Karachi, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Sialkot, Peshawar, and all Pakistan cities.
- **Payment Methods**: Cash on Delivery (COD), Direct Bank Transfer (IBFT), Corporate Accounts Payable (terms available for contract clients).
- **Direct WhatsApp Ordering**: Customers can order directly via WhatsApp at https://wa.me/923171678829 with instant carton quotations, packing confirmations, and delivery coordination.
